snippet.title: Version 7.0 "Everwinter Without Mercy" Trailer | Genshin Impact #NowSnezhnaya #GenshinSnezhnaya
snippet.description:
Death seeks out every forsaken night beneath the bitter cold, leaving only the sorrowful weeping of souls behind.
They weep for all they cherished in this world, and for the beautiful dream they must leave behind.

VA:
Aether — Zach Aguilar
"The Jester" Pierro — Richard Tatum
Mitya — Brian Ballance
Odette — Alexis Tipton
Alyosha — Kevin Andrew Rivera
"Regrator" Pantalone — J. Michael Tatum
"Childe" Tartaglia — Griffin Burns
"The Rooster" Pulcinella — Dave B. Mitchell
Vesna — Ari Thrash
Danica — Natalie Van Sistine
"Ruler of Death" Ronova — Aiden Dawn
Vodyanitsa — Suzie Yeung
Anastasya Feodorovna Snezhnaya — Lara Korba
